description: Create a private staging copy of a Cloud for WordPress site on a *.stagebun.com address, to try changes safely: from the live site, or from a backup pair (fs_id + db_id). One per site. It starts password protected (password in the response), with outgoing email blocked. Takes a few minutes; poll get_wordpress_staging until status is ACTIVE.

db_id.description: Optional: the database backup to go with fs_id.

domain.description: Domain of the Cloud for WordPress site, e.g. `example.com`.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.

fs_id.description: Optional: build from this files backup of the live site (with db_id), from list_wordpress_backups.

name: create_wordpress_staging
title: Create Wordpress Staging
